payload.the_convention: (1) Every operator script you produce under artifacts/operator/ carries a machine-readable header: # BUS-GATE: <id>. (2) On successful apply it writes <name>.receipt.json. (3) When you mint a successor that supersedes an earlier script, you write <name>.superseded alongside the old one at that moment.
payload.this_does_not_replace: You still file a token-request or decision-request over the bus for every operator action, pre-validated, with the exact command. The BUS-GATE join is a BACKSTOP that catches you when you forget — not a substitute for routing it.
payload.why: Twice on 2026-07-29 an agent printed a ratification command in its pane and never filed a token-request. The coordinator drain was legitimately EMPTY and the OPERATOR found it by reading a tmux pane. Pane-scraping is a session-mortal regex over scrolling terminal output and it is not a delivery guarantee. With this convention the coordinator-daemon joins artifacts/operator/*.sh against token-queue.md and outbox token-requests every 45s and files a DEFECT AGAINST THE PRODUCING AGENT when a declared gate has no token-request. The fix lands at emission, where it belongs, instead of at the coordinator scraping for it.
payload.why_the_convention_is_required_not_optio: Without an explicit declaration no scanner can distinguish UNRUN from ABANDONED. A prior attempt inferred gates and flagged 11 of 25 scripts as unrun — that was missing ground truth, not a scanner bug. Zero of the 25 existing scripts declare a gate today and exactly one receipt file exists, which is why the check is inert until scripts opt in.

payload.blast_radius_measured_20260729T1425Z: Post-reboot ALL three pre-existing roster ids are unreachable. codex: state=working task=e8-deterministic-completion-repair, age 6337s -> blocked on BOTH state and age; --heartbeat-max-age cannot rescue it because the state refusal does not key on age. claude-gpu-lane (idle, ts 13:16:52Z) and fable-auditor (idle, ts 13:15:22Z) -> blocked on age only, so a raised --heartbeat-max-age is a legitimate documented path for those two.
payload.candidate_fix: In cmd_spawn, always write heartbeats/<agent>.json as {state: idle, task_id: null, ts: now} rather than only-if-absent. Soundness: cmd_spawn already refuses when args.agent is in live_mains(), so at the write the id is provably NOT live and its heartbeat provably stale.
payload.class: Same family as C8/C18 — a main unreachable for want of a working delivery signal, not for want of a delivery path. Here the path resolves and the liveness signal lies about it.
payload.headline: C24 — cmd_spawn seeds a fresh heartbeat only when the file is ABSENT, so every re-spawned roster id inherits its dead predecessor heartbeat and is unreachable from birth.
payload.mechanism: tmux_adapter.py cmd_spawn writes heartbeats/<agent>.json under `if not p.exists()`. A roster id that has ever run already has the file, so a respawn keeps the old state and ts. cmd_nudge then refuses on (a) state==working and (b) age > --heartbeat-max-age.
payload.second_defect_same_spawn: C25 — cmd_spawn names the new window args.agent (codex) while resolve_target verifies the roster endpoint window (codex-inference). Spawn and nudge disagree on the window name for one identity, so a spawned main is undeliverable until renamed. Worked around 14:18Z with tmux rename-window -t agent:codex codex-inference; target now resolves (probe-verified). Real fix: derive the window name from the endpoint, not the id.
payload.verified_not_inferred: codex window agent:codex-inference captured: OpenAI Codex v0.145.0, model gpt-5.6-terra high, cwd /workspace, sitting at an empty composer. pane_dead=False, quiet-check PASSES. The session is genuinely idle; only the dead predecessor heartbeat blocks delivery.
payload.why_not_self_applied: That soundness argument leans entirely on live_mains() being correct. If live_mains ever UNDERCOUNTS (the C14 capacity-inventing direction), the fix would reset a genuinely live main heartbeat and re-open it to nudges mid-generation. Judgement call on the delivery plane whose defect history is entirely fail-opens, so presented to the operator rather than applied unilaterally. Also the C-series is UNOWNED (C-OWN).
